plain_text:
__NOTOC__
Salbutamol, commonly also known as Albuterol or Ventolin is a short acting phenethylamine β2 antagonist. It is used as a treatment for bronchospasm and COPD and induces slight stimulation & wakefulness. Moderate dependence potential has been documented and included in treatment guidelines.

    
Main article: TalkSalbutamol
    
    
Psychoactive class: Stimulant
    
    
Chemical class: Phenethylamine
